text: I am Dr. Agent. I see you have generalized fatigue, severe pruritus, and abnormal liver function tests; to narrow this down, have you noticed any jaundice, dark urine, or pale stools recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 32-year-old male. The patient reports a 2-month history of increasing generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. He has known hypertension and was diagnosed with ulcerative colitis 5 years ago. He mentions being sexually active with 2 female partners and inconsistent condom use.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Hepatitis C infection.

The patient's history of multiple female partners and inconsistent condom use, combined with fatigue, severe pruritus, and abnormal liver function tests, strongly suggests a sexually transmitted viral hepatitis. I will request confirmatory testing. REQUEST TEST: HCV_RNA, Anti-HCV, HBsAg, Total_Bilirubin, Alk_Phosphatase, ALT.
